purpose: Canonical contract for derived architecture/use-case/source-evolution graphs consumed by AI, developers and Admin Development Intelligence.

connectivity.goal: Every SongChart application surface is traceable to a semantic owner/use case or is explicitly classified as framework, infrastructure, specialized, legacy or retiring.
connectivity.orphan_candidate_rule: A SongChart-owned application class with zero inbound graph edges and no entrypoint/framework/infrastructure classification is reviewable as an orphan candidate; detection never deletes source automatically.
connectivity.mutation_rule: Connectivity snapshots are derived from source and contracts. Do not hand-maintain per-class graph metadata merely to satisfy the graph.

views.business: Use-case/journey graph with implementation details hidden.
views.deep: Class/interface/inheritance/dependency graph for AI and debugging.

snapshot_policy.canonical_key: accepted Git SHA when available; otherwise exact candidate SHA for non-release analysis
snapshot_policy.request_rule: Never scan source or rebuild graph in an HTTP request.
snapshot_policy.invalidation: A source/contract/package change marks affected semantic owners stale without forcing immediate rebuild.
snapshot_policy.single_flight: Only one rebuild per graph scope/SHA may execute concurrently.
snapshot_policy.history: Keep accepted-SHA snapshots and precomputed adjacent diffs for architecture time travel.

storage.current_pointer: cache/redis may point to latest completed snapshot; it is not authority

admin_policy.default_behavior: Serve latest completed snapshot immediately; show staleness and offer refresh when needed.
admin_policy.polling: Do not poll when idle. If a rebuild is active, use sparse status refresh or a lightweight event.
